R921.reason: Belief in all God's books and messengers continues into a scripture confirming earlier ones, with the firm in knowledge believing it all.

R192.reason: God's favour in guiding to faith and believers' striving are picked up by completed favour, deepened faith and granted victory.

R650.reason: Promised near victory and believers prevailing over refusers is followed by deniers among scripture-holders being driven out.

R920.reason: The close mentions peoples under treaty and deniers as allies; this opening deals directly with treaties with idolaters.

R986.reason: Repeats that each soul will know what it did, with stars and cosmic upheaval, continuing the same judgment scene.

R744.reason: Promise that God will show signs and the order to recite scripture lead into scripture verses and signs people shun.

R957.reason: The close ends on scripture-holders learning bounty is God's alone; this opens with deniers among scripture-holders being expelled.

R571.reason: Might belonging to God and souls meeting their term continue into God holding all power, knowing secrets, and all returning to Him.

R463.reason: After declaring the one God on whom all depend, another commanded saying seeks refuge in him as Lord, King and God.

R574.reason: Fire for the wretched and a better hereafter are expanded into downcast faces in fire and radiant faces in a garden.

R588.reason: Believers not befriending those who oppose God is restated at once as a command not to befriend God's enemies.

R212.reason: Returning to God and not being turned from his signs lead into testing of professed faith and hoping to meet God.

R157.reason: Patience awaiting the promised punishment and God reviving the dead continue with the giver of life and death and watching for the day.

R366.reason: Atom's weight of deeds shown to scattered people continues into scales weighing heavy or light on the same day.

R630.reason: Those who abandon the messenger for trade and amusement lead naturally to a portrait of insincere hypocrites around him.

R213.reason: Recording guardians, the wicked and denial of judgment day recur as the wicked's inscribed record and woe to deniers of that day.

R396.reason: Man's creation in fine form and his fall continue with man created from a clot who oversteps, yet returns to his Lord.

R538.reason: Light scales and the raging fire are explained by distraction in piling up more, ending in seeing the blazing fire.

R281.reason: A scripture of parables rejected by the uncertain is followed by wise scripture for those certain of the hereafter, versus mockers.

R460.reason: The command to glorify your Lord is answered by everything glorifying God, who gives life and death and is always near.

R371.reason: Two final destinies, fire and pleased believers, are mirrored by heavy scales bringing a pleasing life and light scales the fire.

R334.reason: Do not grieve over their plots is echoed by the warning not to destroy yourself with grief over their unbelief.

R160.reason: Rivalry for more ending in the blazing fire continues with the wealth-hoarder who counts it and is flung into God's fire.

R412.reason: Accounts of messengers told to steady the heart lead directly into the best of stories being told to the listener.

R556.reason: The closing promise that he will be satisfied is repeated, with giving to orphans and beggars continuing the theme of generosity.

R818.reason: The command to remind, with punishment for whoever turns away, is repeated alongside praise of the creating Lord.

R946.reason: The list of servants' virtues, shunning idle talk, spouses, eternal reward, is paralleled by successful believers' virtues and inheritance.

R143.reason: Oaths by night and day continue, with purification, the wretch, and two opposite outcomes for differing efforts.

R405.reason: A rejected reminder and hurried punishment continue with the reminding recitation, proud deniers and punishment not yet tasted.

R554.reason: Uncertainty whether the promised punishment is near or far is answered: a sure punishment they see far, God sees near.

R573.reason: God owning everything and the messenger's authority continue with the ruler of heavens and earth who sent his servant to warn.

R965.reason: If this is from God and you reject it, with signs shown, leads to scripture from God whose signs only deniers dispute.

R434.reason: The hater being cut off without a future is illustrated by a cursed man ruined despite his wealth.

R116.reason: Believers told to pray, give alms and do good are then declared successful for exactly those practices.

R167.reason: Humankind in loss as time passes is exemplified by the wealth-counter who thinks riches will make him last forever.

R139.reason: The charge that he is no messenger is answered by scripture sent to him and messengers speaking their people's language.

R593.reason: They ask when the promise comes and who shields deniers; next someone asks about an unstoppable punishment seen as near.

R376.reason: Arrogance, scheming and the ancients' fate recur as proud deniers, perished earlier generations and punishment not yet tasted.
